scope: Serialization and classic-file-structure rules were checked against the locally supplied ISO 32000-2:2020 sponsored EC3 text, clauses 7.3 and 7.5. The builder intentionally emits unencrypted PDF 1.7, not a conforming PDF 2.0 file: it has neither a 2.0 version declaration nor the file identifier required for that version. Incremental updates, object/xref stream writing and document-level schemas are not verified or implemented.

tests: pagura-write unit tests: exact serialized bytes, names, generations, stream length, sparse xref limits and free chain
requirements.gaps: PDF 2.0 header/ID generation, incremental updates, object/xref stream output, encryption writing, signature preservation and cross-engine validation. Generic serialization does not validate every dictionary schema.

primary_text.edition: ISO 32000-2:2020, sponsored edition with Errata Collection 3
primary_text.method: Read the local text extraction; retain only locators and original paraphrases.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Serialize the two boolean values using the corresponding PDF keywords.
audit_steps.implementation: Uses canonical lowercase tokens.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Write decimal integers and finite decimal reals, without exponent or radix notation.
audit_steps.implementation: Rejects non-finite values and emits real syntax with a decimal point; implementation range is i64/f64.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Serialize arbitrary bytes as pairs of hex digits enclosed by string delimiters.
audit_steps.implementation: Uppercase hex has exactly two digits per byte, including zero; empty strings are supported.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Names exclude NUL and escape delimiter/whitespace/hash bytes, while empty names remain valid.
audit_steps.implementation: Rejects NUL in values and dictionary keys; serialization delegates to the core Name spelling.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Write a delimited sequence of values, including empty or nested arrays.
audit_steps.implementation: Brackets and separating spaces are emitted recursively within budgets.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Use unique direct name keys and value pairs; entry order is semantically irrelevant.
audit_steps.implementation: Core Dictionary guarantees uniqueness and ordered iteration; keys are now validated. Dictionary-specific schemas are outside this serializer.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Emit null explicitly; consumers treat a null dictionary entry as absent.
audit_steps.implementation: Writes the null keyword without inventing a distinct absent value.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Streams are indirect objects with a direct dictionary and an LF or CRLF after stream.
audit_steps.implementation: Builder writes every stream as an indirect object, requires a dictionary, and uses LF separators.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Count only stored data bytes, excluding the separator before endstream; filters require already encoded bytes.
audit_steps.implementation: Overwrites Length from the provided stored bytes; clarified that callers encode data for declared filters.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Bound stream size before serialization while preserving exact stored bytes.
audit_steps.implementation: Checks stream_bytes and annotates the object on rejection. This resource policy is additional to the format.

audit_steps.paraphrase: New files use positive object numbers and generation zero, with matching indirect-reference syntax.
audit_steps.implementation: Rejects nonzero generations during insertion and keeps unique object numbers.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Readers treat an undefined reference as null; this does not require a builder to create dangling references.
audit_steps.implementation: Builder deliberately rejects missing references rather than writing them; stricter construction policy is not claimed a normative requirement.

audit_steps.paraphrase: A basic new file contains a header, indirect-object body, cross-reference section and trailer.
audit_steps.implementation: Emits all four components deterministically.

audit_steps.paraphrase: A file claiming PDF 2.0 conformance declares version 2.0 and follows its required trailer metadata rules.
audit_steps.implementation: Builder intentionally declares PDF 1.7, so it is not advertised as a PDF 2.0-conforming writer.

audit_steps.paraphrase: The header is followed by a comment with at least four high-bit bytes when binary data is possible.
audit_steps.implementation: Writes a binary comment after the LF-terminated version line; offsets start at the initial percent byte.

audit_steps.paraphrase: The body contains the independently numbered indirect object definitions.
audit_steps.implementation: Ascending object number is deterministic policy, not a format requirement.

audit_steps.paraphrase: An initial classic xref section has one contiguous subsection beginning at zero.
audit_steps.implementation: Writes one subsection and covers every hole through the largest object number.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Each classic xref row is 20 bytes with a ten-digit position, five-digit generation, status and valid line ending.
audit_steps.implementation: Writes SP-LF rows and rejects positions beyond ten decimal digits.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Object zero is free with generation 65535; unused entries form a chain returning to zero.
audit_steps.implementation: Links holes in ascending order with initial generations zero.

audit_steps.paraphrase: The xref covers zero through the highest object number, and Size is one above that maximum.
audit_steps.implementation: Checked range arithmetic and object/file budgets prevent overflow or an unbounded sparse scan.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Root is an indirect reference to the catalog dictionary, not a stream.
audit_steps.implementation: Requires an existing catalog dictionary and rejects a stream masquerading as it.

audit_steps.paraphrase: startxref gives the xref byte position and the last content line is the end marker.
audit_steps.implementation: Uses the recorded offset, direct Size and Root, and an LF-terminated end marker.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Encryption, version and update state determine which trailer entries are required.
audit_steps.implementation: Current output is new unencrypted PDF 1.7: Encrypt, Info, Prev and ID are omitted. A future 2.0 writer must add a two-string ID.

audit_steps.paraphrase: Updates, compressed object storage and cross-reference streams have additional formats.
audit_steps.implementation: Builder only produces a fresh classic table; no claim covers these optional structures.
audit_steps.tests: No output path for these structures.
